title: fix: restore Claude Sonnet 5 AWS pricing
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Restores Claude Sonnet 5 provider costs to $2/M input and $10/M output for the exact AWS Bedrock Global Standard route.
- Keeps cache read at $0.20/M, five-minute cache write at $2.50/M, multiplier 1, paid-only access, aliases, and routing unchanged.
- Corrects the premature rollover merged in #13618; AWS's price-list offer published 2026-09-01T18:36:49Z still carries the promotional meters.
- Verified the exact route with text and image input; 528 focused pricing/alias tests and both Enter and Gen typechecks pass.

Source: https://pricing.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/offers/v1.0/aws/AmazonBedrockFoundationModels/current/index.json

gist.headline: Sonnet's spring pricing returns
gist.blurb: The AWS Bedrock Global Standard route is back on Claude Sonnet 5's promotional meters. Polli checked the price list twice; the hive can stop doing invoice archaeology.
gist.summary: Restored Claude Sonnet 5 pricing for the AWS Bedrock Global Standard route to $2/M input and $10/M output, while retaining $0.20/M cache reads, $2.50/M five-minute cache writes, multiplier 1, paid-only access, aliases, and routing.
gist.impact: Users calling Claude Sonnet 5 through AWS Bedrock Global Standard once again receive the published promotional rates for text and image input without changing their existing aliases or routing.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a careful little accountant-gardener restoring correctly labeled price tags to a blooming Claude Sonnet 5 code-plant beside a cozy AWS Bedrock-style cloud-and-terminal station. A friendly CRT Monitor Robot can hold a tiny price-list scroll, while prominent lime green route markers and small flowers make the corrected Global Standard path feel clear and welcoming.
